what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from the Philippines in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6088 Philippine asylum seekers, and Australia hosted 49.5% of them.
After Australia, the largest hosts are Italy, South Korea and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of the Philippines with the CPP in every year from 1999 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over Mindanao territory from 1995 to 2020 and with the Islamic State group from 2016 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 1848 asylum seekers, and the figure fell to a low in 2011.
It then rose, reaching its highest point, 8081, at the end of 2017; the main years of displacement in the data are 2017 and 2019 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
